# Draft:Kingsmen Labour Recruitment

Kingsmen is a United Kingdom–based construction services company specialising in construction labour supply and built environment logistics. The company provides workforce solutions and logistics planning services to organisations operating in the construction and infrastructure sectors.
Overview
Kingsmen operates as a labour supply provider within the construction industry, maintaining a database of operatives across multiple trades and skill levels. The company provides workforce recruitment services supported by payroll administration systems designed to support regulatory compliance, including HMRC-compliant payroll processes.
The company supplies labour to construction projects across the United Kingdom, supporting both new-build and refurbishment works. Kingsmen states that its systems and payroll processes have been reviewed by organisations including John Sisk, Datum RPO, M Group, and Gallagher.
Services
Construction labour supply
Kingsmen provides temporary and project-based labour to contractors operating across residential, commercial, and infrastructure sectors. The company maintains a database of workers across construction trades and supports workforce placement, payroll processing, and compliance administration.
Built environment logistics
Kingsmen provides construction logistics services, including planning and coordination of site operations, workforce movement, and materials logistics. The company states that it supports logistics planning for projects in urban and high-activity environments, including new-build and refurbishment developments.
Social value initiatives
Kingsmen has participated in skills and employment initiatives intended to support access to job opportunities within the construction sector. The company has engaged with programmes including LTC Skills Hub and has worked with training providers delivering government-funded skills programmes designed to support individuals seeking employment in construction roles.
The company has also collaborated with stakeholders in local government, including Kent County Council, in relation to workforce development initiatives.
Leadership
Prav Mengar is the founder and Managing Director of Kingsmen. Prav is very well known and active in early engagment construction networks and is is influentional on LinkedIn.
Prior to founding Kingsmen, Mengar worked in the property sector, including roles with estate agencies Keller Williams and Wards.
Mengar also directed Abba Dart, a taxi business based in Sidcup, London.
Industry context
Construction labour supply companies operate within the wider built environment sector, providing workforce flexibility to support delivery of construction and infrastructure projects. Logistics coordination is an aspect of construction management, particularly in urban environments requiring detailed planning of workforce movement and materials handling.
